audience: salon, spa and wellness business owners and managers who run appointments and clients in Boulevard

useCases.title: Look at appointments at a location
useCases.text: The AI lists appointments at a location, filtered by client, date range or staff member. Each one shows its client, services, staff and state.

useCases.title: Check staff shifts and blocked time
useCases.text: The AI lists staff working shifts for a date range, and the blocked time such as breaks and meetings. You see who works when.

useCases.title: Review checkout orders and totals
useCases.text: The AI lists checkout orders at a location with subtotal, discount, tax, gratuity, total and refunds, and opens one with its line items. You can sum up a week.

useCases.title: Check memberships and their next charge
useCases.text: The AI lists client memberships with status, price, interval and next charge date. You can find paused or past-due ones.

useCases.title: Find, create or update a client, or add a note
useCases.text: The AI finds a client by email, phone or name, creates a new client, updates their details or adds an internal note. It can check for a duplicate first.
